review_kind: Read-only independent source review, including final clock/source-change hardening; no independent test rerun
findings: Count and full ordered eligible selection occur within one query-only SQLite transaction. No LIMIT or partial tail is accepted; last24h covers the unchanged current-topic maximum1440-minute publication window. Unknown publication clocks and incomplete or over-cap inputs fail closed.

Retained raw payload and row hashes permit deterministic replay. Canonical original first-seen is restored from retained DB columns exactly as the frozen collector loader; member expiry is never renewed by this observation.

Original singleton and duplicate-topic guards are replayed. Exact duplicates across compatible variants may collapse; conflicting member content, incompatible full-topic metadata and repeated member identities within an input cannot gain support through reconciliation.

Each upstream heartbeat and clock wrapper must be current. Original broker source age must also be independently nonnegative and totalage<=90; external HTTPS evidence is independently aged. Previously future broker quotes cannot be rehabilitated by elapsed wrapper time.

The producer computes the sole deterministic replay before sampling generated time and rechecks semantic source bytes before assembly. Snapshot publication and its heartbeat use distinct actual boundaries.
Four-generation immutable replay cache checks full payload hash and exact seven-source closure before reuse; callers retain their own current freshness/consumer checks.
Atomic output failure cannot produce a claimed-current heartbeat; no existing output, source governance DB, classifier or trading control is mutated.
clock_precision_note: database_snapshot_epoch records the read-start lower bound sampled before BEGIN/first read, not exact SQLite snapshot acquisition. Read completion and subsequent consumer availability remain separate actual clocks.
